# Mirage 1.1.0
本版本带来视频和场景动态锁屏、独立的屏保动态锁屏配置，并修复动态锁屏组件升级、视频循环、屏保显示尺寸、锁屏退出后的桌面回退和场景木偶动画等问题。
## 重大更新：动态锁屏与屏保壁纸
- 新增原生动态锁屏支持：视频和场景壁纸可以在锁屏界面继续播放或渲染，解锁后恢复桌面壁纸显示。此功能使用 macOS 26 的系统 API，仅在 macOS 26 或更高版本可用。 - 新增屏保动态锁屏模式，可在屏保设置中启用；屏保可以使用独立配置的场景或视频壁纸，不再只能跟随当前播放壁纸。此方案使用 Mirage 屏保组件，支持 macOS 14.2 或更高版本。 - 改进动态锁屏和屏保组件的生命周期与桌面回退：修复动态内容泄漏到桌面、退出 Mirage 后锁屏状态失效，以及锁屏退出后桌面未及时恢复的问题。 - 屏保配置与屏保动态锁屏配置现在相互独立，分别更新和恢复，避免更换其中一项时覆盖另一项。 - 加强动态锁屏组件的安装与升级：自动清理旧版或重复注册的原生锁屏扩展，停用方案 A 时注销扩展，并迁移旧版屏保动态锁屏组件及已有系统墙纸配置。
## 播放与屏保修复
- 修复视频壁纸循环切换时的间隙，使视频循环衔接更加连续；视频资源也可在锁屏和屏保环境中稳定加载。 - 改进屏保组件的显示尺寸校正，按屏幕实际显示尺寸更新布局，减少缩放显示器下的错位和比例异常（Issue #24）。 - 修复多个场景屏保实例使用不同配置时相互替换渲染状态的问题；每组配置现在使用独立的渲染实例，并分别处理暂停与销毁。
## 场景渲染修复
- 修复木偶动画的图层混合与可见性处理，使带有动画可见性条件的场景能够正确响应运行时属性变化（Issue #37）。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 应用与屏保组件要求 macOS 14.2 或更高版本；原生动态锁屏功能要求 macOS 26 或更高版本
当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.1.0
This release adds video and Scene dynamic lock screens, an independently configured screen-saver dynamic lock screen, and fixes dynamic lock-screen component upgrades, video looping, screen-saver display sizing, desktop fallback after unlocking or quitting, and Scene puppet animation layering.
## Major Update: Dynamic Lock Screen and Screen Saver Wallpapers
- Added native dynamic lock-screen support for video and Scene wallpapers. They can continue playing or rendering on the lock screen, with the desktop wallpaper restored after unlocking. This feature uses macOS 26 system APIs and is available only on macOS 26 or later. - Added a Screen Saver Dynamic Lock Screen mode that can be enabled from Screen Saver settings. The screen saver can use an independently configured Scene or video wallpaper instead of always following the current playing wallpaper. This mode uses the Mirage screen-saver component and supports macOS 14.2 or later. - Improved dynamic lock-screen and screen-saver component lifecycle and desktop fallback behavior. Fixed dynamic content leaking onto the desktop, lock-screen state being lost when Mirage quits, and the desktop not being restored promptly after unlocking. - Screen-saver and Screen Saver Dynamic Lock Screen configurations are now independent and are updated and restored separately, so changing one no longer overwrites the other. - Hardened dynamic lock-screen component installation and upgrades by removing obsolete or duplicate native lock-screen extension registrations, unregistering Method A when disabled, and migrating legacy Screen Saver Dynamic Lock Screen components and existing system wallpaper configuration.
## Playback and Screen Saver Fixes
- Fixed gaps when video wallpapers loop or switch, making playback transitions more continuous; video assets also load more reliably in lock-screen and screen-saver environments. - Improved screen-saver display sizing by updating layout for the display's actual dimensions, reducing misalignment and aspect-ratio errors on scaled displays (Issue #24). - Fixed Scene screen-saver instances with different configurations replacing each other's rendering state. Each configuration now uses an independent renderer with separate pause and teardown handling.
## Scene Rendering Fix
- Fixed puppet animation layer blending and visibility handling so scenes with animation visibility conditions respond correctly to runtime property changes (Issue #37).
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.0.9
本版本重点增强 Steam 会话与创意工坊下载的故障恢复能力，并修复多标签筛选、场景效果采样、视频纹理刷新和 MetalFX 呈现稳定性。
## 重大更新：Steam 会话与下载恢复
- Steam 连接短暂中断时会使用稳定的登录标识和已保存的刷新令牌自动重连，并通过有界退避持续恢复；只有 Steam 明确拒绝保存的会话时才要求重新登录，减少网络波动导致的意外掉线。 - Steam 服务组件意外退出后会自动重启、恢复登录并重新提交仍在进行的下载任务。下载暂存目录与已校验分块会被复用，不再因服务或连接中断丢弃已经下载的内容。 - 改进 Steam 内容服务器选择与容错：缓存可用服务器、降低失败节点优先级，并为清单和内容分块增加跨服务器重试。单个下载现在可使用全局八个分块连接，多个任务同时运行时共享该上限。
## 创意工坊修复
- 修复同时选择多个标签时可能错误返回空结果的问题；查询现在按“匹配任一所选标签”合并并去重结果，同时保留其他筛选条件 (PR #35)。
## 场景渲染修复
- 修复透传效果未始终保留独立采样相机，以及合成图层绑定到错误渲染目标的问题，改善非全屏效果、后处理和合成场景的显示。 - 修复资源刷新重新划分视频纹理活动周期，导致部分场景中的视频材质停止更新的问题；相同的填充模式也不再触发重复资源刷新。 - 加强 MetalFX 呈现器的能力检查、纹理输入和线性回退路径，并将 MetalFX 默认改为关闭；用户仍可在性能设置中手动启用。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本

# Mirage 1.0.9
This release strengthens recovery for Steam sessions and Workshop downloads while fixing multi-tag filtering, Scene effect sampling, video-texture refreshes, and MetalFX presentation stability.
## Major Update: Steam Session and Download Recovery
- Temporary Steam connection losses now recover automatically using a stable login ID and the saved refresh token, with bounded backoff between attempts. Mirage asks for another login only when Steam explicitly rejects the saved session, reducing unexpected sign-outs caused by network interruptions. - If the Steam service exits unexpectedly, Mirage restarts it, restores the session, and resubmits active download tasks. Staged files and already validated chunks are reused instead of discarding downloaded content after a service or connection interruption. - Improved Steam content-server selection and failover by caching available servers, deprioritizing failing hosts, and retrying manifests and content chunks across servers. A single download can now use all eight global chunk connections, while concurrent items share that limit.
## Workshop Fixes
- Fixed multi-tag filtering sometimes returning no results. Queries now merge and deduplicate items matching any selected tag while retaining the other active filters (PR #35).
## Scene Rendering Fixes
- Fixed passthrough effects not always retaining a dedicated sampling camera and composite layers binding to the wrong render target, improving non-fullscreen effects, post-processing, and composite scenes. - Fixed resource refreshes advancing the video-texture activity cycle and consequently stopping some video materials from updating. Reapplying an unchanged fill mode also no longer triggers another resource refresh. - Hardened MetalFX presenter capability checks, texture inputs, and linear fallback behavior. MetalFX is now disabled by default and remains available as an opt-in setting under Performance.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - Requires macOS 14.2 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.0.8
本版本重点恢复复杂场景壁纸的脚本、动画与渲染兼容性，并重做创意工坊发现页、加入 Steam 收藏同步和更灵活的筛选。还修复了网页音频频谱、多显示器启动恢复、旋转屏幕锁屏壁纸和应用图标等问题。
## 重大更新：场景壁纸兼容性
- 大幅完善 Wallpaper Engine 场景运行时兼容性，恢复脚本驱动的图层可见性与顺序、属性写入、鼠标交互、动画事件、相机切换及木偶动画；动态壁纸不再因运行时状态不同步而静止、交互失效或丢失动画。 - 修复合成层与效果渲染，确保渲染图、着色器、纹理、Metal 桥接纹理和效果绑定在刷新或重建后继续有效；同时拆分大型网格上传，减少复杂场景因资源失效或上传过大而黑屏、缺层或停止播放的情况。 - 扩展场景文档、粒子、模型与木偶数据解析，保留作者定义的图层元数据和标量原点，并修复创意工坊字体路径、文字与不透明背景透明度，提升更多既有壁纸的还原度。
## 重大更新：创意工坊发现与收藏
- 重做“发现”页：按最近好评、当下热门、音频响应、题材、精选创作者和作品集等分区展示内容，支持站内搜索、查看完整分区、分页、刷新及缓存回退。 - 新增 Steam 创意工坊收藏同步，可在壁纸卡片、详情页、右键菜单和已安装壁纸中直接收藏或取消收藏；资料库、创意工坊和已订阅页面均可筛选“我的收藏”。 - “仅显示”筛选现在统一支持广受好评、我的收藏、音频响应和可自定义；创意工坊与已订阅页面还可同时选择场景、网页、视频和预设等多种壁纸类型。修复多标签筛选，勾选多个标签时会显示匹配其中任一标签的作品，不再因要求同时包含全部标签而错误返回空结果。
## 播放与系统修复
- 修复网页壁纸音频频谱的 vDSP 实数 DFT 输入布局，频率不再落入错误的半频位置，高频段也能正确参与音频可视化 (PR #34)。 - 修复多显示器启动时仅检查当前选中屏幕，导致其他显示器已保存的壁纸无法恢复的问题 (PR #33)。 - 修复使用旋转显示器时，锁屏屏保壁纸无法按当前逻辑尺寸铺满的问题 (#24)。 - 修复 Dock 与启动台中的应用图标显示过大的问题 (#23)。
## 界面与稳定性
- 改进创意工坊网格、已订阅工具栏、筛选侧栏和紧凑窗口布局，并扩大主窗口默认与最小尺寸，减少控件挤压、裁切和错位。 - 修复性能设置中的帧率滑块布局不稳定，以及隐藏页面仍影响当前页面布局的问题。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本

# Mirage 1.0.8
This release focuses on restoring scripting, animation, and rendering compatibility for complex Scene wallpapers. It also rebuilds Workshop discovery, adds synchronized Steam favorites, and introduces more flexible filtering. Web audio spectra, multi-display launch restoration, rotated-display screen savers, and application icon sizing are fixed as well.
## Major Update: Scene Wallpaper Compatibility
- Significantly expanded Wallpaper Engine Scene runtime compatibility by restoring script-driven layer visibility and ordering, writable properties, pointer interaction, animation events, camera transitions, and puppet animation. Dynamic wallpapers no longer become static, lose interaction, or drop animations when runtime state falls out of sync. - Fixed composite and effect rendering so render graphs, shaders, textures, bridged Metal textures, and effect bindings remain valid after refreshes or rebuilds. Large mesh uploads are now split to reduce blank output, missing layers, and stopped playback in complex scenes. - Expanded Scene document, particle, model, and puppet parsing, preserved authored layer metadata and scalar origins, and fixed Workshop font paths plus text and opaque-background alpha for more faithful rendering of existing wallpapers.
## Major Update: Workshop Discovery and Favorites
- Rebuilt Discover around sections such as recently approved, popular now, audio-responsive, genre, featured creator, and collection content. It now supports in-app search, full-section browsing, pagination, refresh, and cached fallback. - Added synchronized Steam Workshop favorites. Items can be favorited or unfavorited from cards, details, context menus, and installed wallpapers, while Library, Workshop, and Subscribed views can filter to My Favorites. - Show Only filters now consistently cover Approved, My Favorites, Audio Responsive, and Customizable. Workshop and Subscribed views can also select multiple wallpaper types, including Scene, Web, Video, and Preset. Multi-tag filtering now returns items matching any selected tag instead of incorrectly requiring every selected tag and often producing empty results.
## Playback and System Fixes
- Fixed the vDSP real-DFT input layout used by web-wallpaper audio spectra. Frequencies no longer appear at half their actual position, and the upper frequency range is represented correctly (PR #34). - Fixed launch restoration checking only the selected display and consequently skipping persisted wallpapers on other displays (PR #33). - Fixed screen-saver wallpapers failing to fill the logical display bounds on rotated monitors (#24). - Fixed oversized application icons in the Dock and Launchpad (#23).
## Interface and Stability
- Improved Workshop grids, the Subscribed toolbar, filter sidebars, and compact-window layouts. The main window also has larger default and minimum dimensions to reduce control compression, clipping, and misalignment. - Fixed unstable frame-rate slider layout in Performance settings and hidden sections continuing to affect the active page's layout.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - Requires macOS 14.2 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.0.7
本版本带来创意工坊已订阅壁纸管理的重大升级：Mirage 现在可以直接读取和管理 Steam 订阅、批量补齐未下载壁纸，并在应用内查看与发表评论。同时改进网页壁纸信任控制、视频播放稳定性和分发包签名。
## 重大更新：已订阅壁纸管理
- 新增独立的“已订阅”页面，直接读取当前 Steam 账号的 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊订阅，并显示作品详情、安装状态和分页结果；可按标题、作者、Workshop ID 或标签搜索，并按壁纸类型、内容分级、分辨率和标签筛选。 - 创意工坊详情页现在可以直接“订阅并下载”或取消订阅。订阅成功后会自动加入下载队列；取消订阅会停止对应任务并删除 Mirage 下载目录中的副本，但不会删除 Steam 内容目录中的文件。 - 新增“下载全部”，会先统计全部订阅，只把尚未安装且未在下载队列中的可用作品加入任务，避免重复下载。 - 作品详情页新增 Steam 评论浏览、分页和发布功能，并显示评论作者、时间、赞数及隐藏状态；已安装壁纸的菜单也可复制创意工坊链接或前往 Steam 查看和举报。
## 安全与稳定性
- 网页壁纸安全确认现在明确区分“信任并继续”和“仅本次继续”。持久信任改为按标准化壁纸目录记录，避免不同目录中同名壁纸错误共享信任，并兼容已有信任记录与目录迁移。 - 修复 Steam 会话恢复期间仍可发起新的登录或创意工坊操作的问题；界面会等待恢复完成后再开放相关操作，减少重复登录、状态闪烁和会话竞争。 - 改进视频壁纸的内存映射播放：资源按块提供给 AVFoundation，兼容其内容类型协商，并在播放无进度时进行有界恢复；快照完成后也会及时移除临时视频输出，降低大文件或长时间播放时卡住的概率。 - 改进正式包的签名链：保留内置 .NET 运行时的 Apple 签名，显式签名 Sparkle 更新组件和应用权限，并在 CI 中验证 Steam 服务、Sparkle 与应用签名。
## 修复
- 修复自定义导入目录与创意工坊目录设置为同一路径时，其中一个来源在设置界面消失的问题；两个来源现在会分别显示，实际扫描仍会去重，避免壁纸重复 (#22)。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本

# Mirage 1.0.7
This release delivers a major upgrade to Workshop subscription management. Mirage can now read and manage Steam subscriptions directly, download missing subscribed wallpapers in bulk, and browse or post comments in the app. It also improves web-wallpaper trust controls, video playback stability, and package signing.
## Major Update: Subscribed Wallpaper Management
- Added a dedicated Subscribed page that reads Wallpaper Engine Workshop subscriptions from the current Steam account and shows item details, installation state, and paginated results. Subscriptions can be searched by title, creator, Workshop ID, or tag and filtered by wallpaper type, content rating, resolution, and tags. - Workshop details now support Subscribe and Download as well as unsubscribe. A successful subscription is added to the download queue automatically. Unsubscribing stops the matching task and removes Mirage's managed download, without deleting files from Steam content directories. - Added Download All, which scans the full subscription list and queues only available items that are neither installed nor already downloading. - Workshop details now support browsing, paging through, and posting Steam comments, including author, timestamp, upvote, and hidden-state information. Installed-wallpaper menus can also copy the Workshop link or open the item on Steam for viewing or reporting.
## Security and Stability
- Web-wallpaper confirmation now clearly separates Trust and Continue from Continue Once. Persistent trust is keyed by the standardized wallpaper directory, preventing same-named wallpapers in different folders from sharing trust while remaining compatible with existing records and path migration. - Fixed new login or Workshop actions being available while a saved Steam session was still restoring. Mirage now waits for restoration to finish before enabling those actions, reducing duplicate login attempts, state flicker, and session races. - Improved memory-mapped video wallpaper playback. Resources are delivered to AVFoundation in chunks with content-type negotiation, stalled playback receives bounded recovery, and temporary video outputs are removed after snapshots, reducing stalls with large files or long-running playback. - Improved the release package signing chain by preserving Apple's signatures on the bundled .NET runtime, explicitly signing Sparkle update components and app entitlements, and verifying the Steam service, Sparkle, and app signatures in CI.
## Fixes
- Fixed one library source disappearing from Settings when the custom import directory and Workshop directory pointed to the same path. Both sources remain visible while filesystem scanning is still deduplicated to avoid duplicate wallpapers (#22).
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - Requires macOS 14.2 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.0.6
本版本重点改进从旧版下载目录升级时的数据迁移、Steam 创意工坊下载稳定性与登录启动，并优化已安装壁纸预览和场景绳索粒子的渲染兼容性。
## 迁移与兼容性
- 现在会自动检测 V1.0.5 之前由 Mirage 下载到旧 SteamCMD 目录的创意工坊壁纸，并在确认后将其移动到新的 Mirage 下载目录。迁移不会覆盖已有项目；未迁移的壁纸仍可在资料库中使用。 - 迁移壁纸时会同步更新各显示器的壁纸分配、运行时设置、播放列表、收藏、快捷键、信任记录和屏幕保护程序配置，避免目录变化导致既有设置失效。 - 修复场景壁纸的绳索与拖尾粒子在 CPU 几何生成路径中忽略作者细分设置的问题；现在会按细分值生成平滑的贝塞尔曲线，并为新增顶点预留正确容量。
## 修复
- 改进 Steam 会话恢复：临时认证或连接故障会进行有界重试，不再误删有效的已保存会话；钥匙串读取、写入和删除错误也会明确反馈。 - 每次创意工坊下载和重试现在使用独立任务标识，避免上一次尝试的取消或迟到事件影响新任务；同时明确区分用户取消与意外中断，并保证只发送一次完成状态。 - 使用独立的登录项辅助程序处理“登录时启动”，自动迁移旧注册方式；后台登录启动不再错误显示主窗口，手动启动仍会转发到已运行的 Mirage 实例。
## 性能与文档
- 已安装壁纸预览改用统一的缩略图降采样与内存缓存，并限制大型动画预览的解码开销；不可见或停止动画的项目会及时释放动画数据，降低浏览大型资料库时的内存与 CPU 占用。 - 恢复批量获取已订阅 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊内容的指南，说明如何通过 Valve SteamCMD 下载订阅项目并将目录接入 Mirage；Mirage 内置下载服务仍保持独立。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本

# Mirage 1.0.6
This release focuses on migrating data from legacy download folders, improving Steam Workshop download stability and login launch behavior, and optimizing installed-wallpaper previews and Scene rope-particle rendering compatibility.
## Migration and Compatibility
- Mirage now detects Workshop wallpapers downloaded by pre-1.0.5 versions into the legacy SteamCMD folders and, after confirmation, moves them into the new Mirage Downloads folder. Migration never overwrites an existing item, and wallpapers that remain in legacy folders stay available in the library. - When wallpapers move, Mirage updates display assignments, runtime settings, playlists, favorites, shortcuts, trust records, and screen-saver configuration so existing setup continues to work with the new paths. - Fixed Scene wallpaper rope and trail particles ignoring authored subdivision settings on the CPU geometry-generation path. Mirage now emits smooth Bezier subsegments and reserves the correct vertex capacity for them.
## Fixes
- Improved Steam session restoration. Temporary authentication or connection failures now receive bounded retries without deleting a valid saved session, and Keychain read, write, and deletion failures are reported clearly. - Each Workshop download and retry now has an independent attempt identifier, preventing cancellation or late events from a previous attempt from affecting a new one. User cancellation and unexpected interruption are distinguished, and completion is emitted exactly once. - Added a dedicated login-item helper and automatic migration from the previous registration method. Login launches no longer show the main window unexpectedly, while manual launches still forward to an existing Mirage instance.
## Performance and Documentation
- Installed-wallpaper previews now share thumbnail downsampling and memory caching while limiting the decode cost of large animations. Off-screen items and previews that stop animating release animation data promptly, reducing memory and CPU use in large libraries. - Restored the guide for fetching subscribed Wallpaper Engine Workshop content in bulk. It explains how to use Valve's SteamCMD for subscribed items and add that directory to Mirage, while Mirage's embedded downloader remains independent.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - Requires macOS 14.2 or later
